counterfactual_results.note: Protocol failures remain recorded as failures; no local semantic alias or fallback label mapping was added.

evidence_driven_changes.finding: Several otherwise valid performances had speech but no audible delivery direction.
evidence_driven_changes.change: Require at least one externally audible pace, volume, breath, articulation, pause, or vocal-target direction when speech is present.
evidence_driven_changes.result: 6/6 revised performances included audible delivery and passed blind review.

evidence_driven_changes.finding: An eleven-year-old actor used adult procedural language and a high-pressure actor repeated a question already answered.
evidence_driven_changes.change: Expose age/life-stage as a shaping input and instruct cognition to respond to an answered cue's consequence rather than restating the same question.
evidence_driven_changes.result: Direct-refusal and pressure-break cases both scored 5 after revision.

evidence_driven_changes.finding: A nonhuman actor recited its value statement as dialogue.
evidence_driven_changes.change: Treat values, preferences, and voice as private behavioral basis; prohibit them from authorizing speech atoms.
evidence_driven_changes.result: The revised nonhuman dialogue omitted the value-card wording and scored 5.

evidence_driven_changes.finding: A mechanic identity failed a gate role-swap because the original counterfactual did not make mechanical attention locally relevant.
evidence_driven_changes.change: Replace arbitrary swaps with frozen, locally relevant counterfactual situations.
evidence_driven_changes.result: 3 valid localized swaps passed; one additional swap failed structurally and remains recorded.

remaining_risks: One localized role-swap performance failed the audible-delivery protocol after retries.
One actor in the revised same-stimulus run failed the addressee protocol, so the group review was not run.
Task-failure performance retained a minor hand-position continuity issue noted by blind reviewers.
The current generation and judge calls use the same model family; future promotion evidence should add model-family-balanced judges and human calibration.
